build_config_object: build a config object by dispatching to the correct constructor via cfg_obj_map using the config class name
build_with_kwargs: build a config object and pass additional keyword arguments through to the constructor
review_build_dispatch: review the build function that dispatches config objects to their corresponding constructors using a class name lookup
refactor_cfg_obj_map: refactor the cfg_obj_map dictionary to add or remove config class constructors for the build dispatcher
summarize_build_function: summarize the build function that resolves a config class name and calls the matching constructor from cfg_obj_map
